channel.title: Caurium build log
channel.description: A dated record of changes to the Caurium public site. No product is available.

item.title: Public copy rewritten around reader questions
item.description: The home page now starts with the failure modes the modules are designed for, then states what each module would do. All four remain Planned.

item.title: Claims register published
item.description: Every public claim now has a page, a stage and an evidence status. Claims without evidence are marked as such.

item.title: Documentation aligned with the public stage model
item.guid: 2026-10-28-Documentation aligned with the public stage model
item.description: Region, price, SLA and contact claims were removed pending evidence. The documentation now describes intended design only.

item.title: Product pages add use cases, design decisions and open questions
item.guid: 2026-10-28-Product pages add use cases, design decisions and open questions
item.description: Each module page now records why its boundary is drawn where it is, and what is still undecided.

item.title: Five production blockers recorded
item.description: Legal entity, security reporting channel, domain verification, Lighthouse results and the operating entity are still open.

item.title: Public site rebuilt around product stages and boundaries
item.guid: 2026-10-28-Public site rebuilt around product stages and boundaries
item.description: The site is a static export. It has no account, API key, payment flow or live product endpoint.
